doc.title: Greg Caputo interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 14, 1998

title: Closing remarks and cruise banter
summary: Final thanks, jokes about shuffleboard, and wishes for the Europe trip.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: If I was on it I would not expect to see the band members doing any shuffleboard.
There’s tickets available by the way.
Oh yeah? It sounds like a nice place to be, and I hope you see some nice things in Europe.
And I hope you get to play in an odd time signature sometime soon.
Thanks a lot. © Fillius Jazz Archive -19-
